fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-08-29 states that messages threatening harm were sent to the complainant following a disagreement over a boundary issue, on 2025-08-28 at approximately 16:10. Vasanthi Kannan approached Erode South PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000288. The complaint refers to Siva Muthu, a business acquaintance, reachable on 9000000256. Jagan Raman (mobile 9000000369) was named as a possible person of interest. Items referenced in the complaint: social media screenshots and mobile phone records.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Social media screenshot; Mobile phone record
fields.Modus_Operandi: Messages reportedly sent from an unfamiliar number.
fields.Keywords: threat, text messages, screenshot, residential colony, suspect, associate, phone records, mobile number
